QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_48

question.text: "The MOIC of an AIF is the aggregate of its DPI and RVPI when all capital calls have been met." This statement is:

answer.text: True only for Cat III AIFs
True only for Cat I AIFs

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Ch 9.7.4.4 and Sample Q5: TRUE. When all capital calls are met, Total Invested Capital = Total Paid-in Capital, so MOIC = TVPI = DPI + RVPI. **The Trap:** Option B is wrong per Ch 9. Options C and D invent category-specific rules that don't exist. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-A/B tests MOIC/TVPI equivalence. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Be careful: for funds that recycle distributions into new investments (venture funds with recycling provisions), MOIC on invested capital may exceed TVPI on paid-in. Disclose the policy and which multiple the reported figure refers to.
